theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the strongest non-AI eligible theme and the clear challenger in the rotation read (score 1.375 vs AI's 1.56, margin 0.185). It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, has the second-highest durability bar (0.62), strong breadth (0.636 — among the widest in the eligible set), and is NOT crowded (z 0.93). Unlike the leader it carries a positive breadth signal, implying participation rather than a narrow top-heavy rally. I lean toward it not because of rank but because trend-gate eligibility plus broad participation plus non-crowding gives it the cleanest staying-power profile in the current chop.

theses.dissent: Energy breadth is coincident, not predictive — the wide participation could mark a late-stage move that has already absorbed inflow, and the rank itself has no forward edge. The 0.469 directional track record says this is a low-conviction lean at best.
